description: ASR ProtectionContainer `fabricSpecificDetails` is polymorphic on instanceType, but the spec declares no subtype of `ProtectionContainerFabricSpecificDetails`, so the converted model keeps only `instanceType` and S.Struct strips every other field on decode. Retype it as an untyped document.
